assumptions.statement: All submitted scope and key-area polygons use the repository provisional geometry. Public Issue #846 reports a material mismatch with separately observed corridor references; neither source is an official boundary.
assumptions.impact: Coordinates, derived areas, ratios, figures, and conceptual locations are intake-only and must be regenerated as one chain when cleared official polygons arrive.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official or rights-cleared boundary package with source, version, CRS, and conversion record.

assumptions.statement: Approved regulatory controls, land parcels, road redlines, heritage controls, municipal utilities, fire access, and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Land use, building form, roads, green space, and phasing are conceptual recommendations, not statutory or engineering conclusions.

assumptions.statement: No cleared housing-stock, rent, vacancy, household, tenure, eligibility, or displacement baseline is available for the site.
assumptions.impact: The proposal defines spatial types, service contracts, and evaluation questions but deliberately leaves unit counts, rent levels, affordability shares, and allocation quotas unknown.

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprints, heights, uses, structural condition, ownership, and heritage status are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Submitted building polygons are scale-and-program prototypes only; every retain, renovate, demolish, or new-build decision remains pending survey and consent.

assumptions.statement: Road sections, station entrances, crossings, walking barriers, traffic counts, curb use, and accessible-route audits are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Routes express desired connection relationships only and cannot be used as alignments, redlines, travel-time claims, or construction feasibility evidence.

assumptions.statement: Public-service capacity, operating hours, staffing, responsible organisations, and service demand are not verified.
assumptions.impact: Care, childcare, night service, appeal desks, and community programmes are a service brief for later co-design, not confirmed provision.
